blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential in robotic surgery for question answering, scene understanding, and grounded assistance, but their high computational cost limits real clinical deployment. Knowledge distillation provides a practical way to build compact surgical MLLMs, yet direct distillation is not well suited to surgical data because surgical samples vary greatly in difficulty, visual ambiguity, and required clinical context, making uniform teacher-student transfer unstable. In addition, the role of supervision changes during training: early stages require stronger teacher guidance for multimodal alignment, while later stages rely more on task supervision for effective optimization. To address these challenges, we propose SurgPace, a complexity-aware continuous curriculum framework for progressive distillation of surgical vision-language models. SurgPace estimates sample complexity using predictive confidence and Lorentz geometric consistency, and uses the fused score to guide a continuous easy-to-hard training process. We further introduce hierarchical representation alignment, which aligns the student with the teacher at the feature, logit, and probability levels, while gradually shifting the training focus from teacher imitation to task supervision. This design separates sample-level curriculum from objective-level scheduling, leading to more stable and effective distillation. We evaluate SurgPace on Surg-396K, a benchmark built from four public surgical datasets and covering five dialogue paradigms. SurgPace consistently outperforms strong MLLM distillation baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness for building compact, memory-efficient surgical MLLMs with faster decoding under controlled benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/hezhicheng2002/SurgPace.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在机器人手术中显示出很强的潜力,用于回答问题,场景理解和被禁助,但其高计算成本限制了真正的临床部署. 知识分馏为构建紧凑的外科MLLMS提供了实用的方法,而直接分馏并不太适合外科数据,因为外科样本在难度,视觉模糊度,以及所需临床环境等方面差异很大,使得统一的师生转移不稳定. 此外,在培训期间,监督改变的作用:早期阶段要求教师对多式联运的调整提供更强有力的指导,而后阶段则更多地依靠任务监督来有效优化。 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议使用SurgPace,这是逐步分解外科视觉语言模型的复杂而持续的课程框架。 SurgPace使用预测置信度和Lorentz几何一致性来估计样本复杂度,并使用被引信分数来指导连续的易硬化训练过程. 我们进一步实行分级代表制,使学生与教师在特征、记录和概率水平上保持一致,同时逐步将培训重点从教师模仿转向任务监督。 这种设计将样本级课程与目标级日程区分开来,导致更稳定有效的蒸馏. 我们在Surg-396K上评价SurgPace,这是由四个公共外科数据集建立的基准,涵盖五个对话范式. SurgPace持续超过强力的MLLM分馏基准,显示出其对构建紧凑,内存高效的外科MLLMs,在受控基准下更快地解码的有效性. 代码见https://github.com/hezhicheng 2002/SurgPace。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Modern surgical care increasingly relies on digital imaging and video streams to support clinical decision-making [ 36 , 29 ] . During minimally invasive procedures, large volumes of visual data are generated, including endoscopic videos, surgical tool trajectories, and intraoperative imaging. These data encode rich information about anatomical structures, surgical actions, and instrument-tissue interactions. Surgeons must continuously interpret these visual signals to infer the current surgical state and make timely decisions [ 53 , 2 ] . As surgical procedures become more complex, the volume and heterogeneity of visual data increase rapidly, which further elevates the cognitive burden on clinicians. In recent years, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for interpreting such complex medical data [ 22 , 19 , 57 ] . By integrating visual perception with language understanding, these models can analyze surgical scenes while interacting with clinicians through natural language. This capability supports applications such as surgical question answering, workflow understanding, procedure summarization, and clinical dialogue assistance. As a result, MLLMs are increasingly regarded as a potential foundation for intelligent surgical assistants that can observe procedures, interpret context, and communicate clinically relevant information during operations [ 39 , 45 , 14 , 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 现代外科护理越来越依赖于数字成像和视频流来支持临床决策[36,29]. 在最低侵入性程序期间,产生了大量视觉数据,包括内视视频、手术工具轨迹和手术内成像。 这些数据编码了有关解剖结构、外科手术和仪器-组织相互作用的丰富信息。 外科医生必须不断地解释这些视觉信号,以推断目前的外科状态并及时作出决定[53,2]. 随着外科手术程序变得更加复杂,视觉数据的体积和异质性迅速增加,这进一步提高了临床医生的认知负担. 近年来,多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)已成为解释这种复杂的医学数据[22、19、57]的有希望范例。 通过将视觉感知与语言理解相结合,这些模型可以在通过自然语言与临床医生互动的同时分析外科手术场景. 这一能力支持诸如外科问答、工作流程理解、程序总结和临床对话援助等应用。 因此,MLLMs越来越被视为智能外科助理的潜在基础,他们在手术期间能够观察程序,解释上下文并交流临床相关信息[39,45,14,13].

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : Overview of the proposed SurgPace framework.
Given surgical multimodal data, a teacher model first estimates sample complexity offline using complementary confidence and geometric consistency signals, which are permissively fused so that lower scores indicate easier samples.
The resulting complexity estimates are then used to guide online curriculum training, where easier samples are emphasized earlier and harder samples are gradually incorporated as training progresses.
During this process, the student model learns from the teacher through hierarchical representation alignment at the probability, logit, and feature levels, while a progressive objective schedule adjusts the balance of supervision over time.
Together, these components enable stable and efficient compression of surgical MLLMs into a lightweight student model with reduced computational demands.
blocks.zh:
图1:拟议SurgPace框架概览。
鉴于外科多模式数据,教师模型首先利用互补的置信度和几何一致性信号对样本复杂性进行线下估计,这些信号可以随意连接,这样较低的分数就表明样本比较容易。
由此产生的复杂性估计数随后用于指导在线课程培训,其中更早地强调比较容易的样本,随着培训的进展逐步纳入较硬的样本。
在这一过程中,学生模式通过在概率,登录,和地物层次的分级代表制调整向教师学习,而渐进的客观时间表则会随着时间的推移来调整监督的平衡.
这些组件共同使外科MLLMs能够稳定而高效地被压缩成轻量级学生模型并降低计算需求.

blocks.en: Despite this promise, the practical deployment of MLLMs in surgical environments remains challenging [ 32 , 15 , 9 ] . Modern MLLMs typically rely on large vision encoders and deep language backbones, which incur substantial computational overhead. These architectures require considerable memory, high-end GPUs, and long inference time [ 44 ] . Such demands conflict with the constraints of real clinical systems, where latency, hardware resources, and system reliability are strictly limited. In operating rooms and robotic surgery platforms, intelligent systems must respond rapidly and reliably, as surgeons often require immediate feedback during critical procedural steps [ 56 , 28 ] . However, MLLMs are usually developed in research settings with abundant computational resources. Their translation into real clinical workflows therefore remains nontrivial [ 21 ] . This gap between model capability and deployment feasibility has become a major barrier to practical surgical multimodal intelligence in real clinical settings.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这一承诺,在外科手术环境中实际部署MLLM仍然具有挑战性[32、15、9]。 现代的MLLMs一般依赖于大型的视觉编码器和深层语言主干线,这些主干线会产生大量的计算间接费用. 这些架构需要相当的内存,高端GPU,以及长的推断时间[44]. 这种要求与真实的临床系统的限制相冲突,临床系统的耐久性,硬件资源和系统可靠性受到严格限制. 在手术室和机器人外科平台中,智能系统必须迅速而可靠地作出反应,因为外科医生在关键的程序步骤中往往需要立即反馈[56,28]. 然而,MLLMs通常是在拥有丰富的计算资源的研究环境中开发的. 因此,将其转化为真正的临床工作流程仍然是非三角性[21]。 模型能力和部署可行性之间的这一差距已成为实际临床环境中实用手术多模式智能的主要障碍。

blocks.en: Transferring multimodal capability from a high-capacity teacher model to a resource-efficient student model remains a fundamental challenge for surgical MLLM systems. Knowledge distillation provides a practical route for compressing MLLMs into compact models with lower computational demands [ 10 , 11 , 59 ] . However, directly applying standard distillation strategies to surgical multimodal tasks often leads to unstable optimization and suboptimal transfer. Several aspects of surgical multimodal learning make this transfer difficult. First, surgical samples differ widely in visual clarity, question complexity, and required clinical context [ 31 , 33 ] . Treating all samples in the same way can cause hard cases to dominate early training and reduce training stability. Second, surgical tasks require joint reasoning over visual appearance, instruments, anatomy, spatial relations, actions, and procedural context [ 54 ] . Distilling only final responses can overlook intermediate cues that support reliable surgical understanding. Third, the useful supervision signal changes during training. Early stages benefit more from teacher-guided supervision for visual and multimodal alignment, while later stages need stronger task supervision to refine final answers. A fixed objective cannot model this change well. These issues limit reliable knowledge transfer in resource-constrained surgical systems, such as operating rooms and robotic platforms.
blocks.zh: 将多式联运能力从高能力教师模式转移到资源效率高的学生模式,仍然是外科MLLM系统的根本挑战。 知识分馏为将MLLMs压缩成计算需求较低的紧凑模型[10,11,59]提供了实用的路径. 然而,将标准蒸馏策略直接应用于外科多模式任务,往往导致不稳定的优化和次优化转移. 手术多模式学习的几个方面使得这种转移变得困难. 首先,外科样本在视觉清晰度,质疑复杂性,以及所需临床环境[31,33]方面差异很大. 以同样的方式对待所有样本,可以使硬病例主导早期培训并降低培训稳定性. 第二,外科手术任务需要针对视觉外观,仪器,解剖学,空间关系,动作,和程序背景进行联合推理[54]. 只有最终反应才能忽略支持可靠外科理解的中间提示。 第三,在培训期间有用的监督信号改变。 对视觉和多模式协调的教师指导监督对早期阶段更有好处,而后期则需要加强任务监督,以完善最终答案。 固定目标不能很好地模拟这种变化。 这些问题限制了资源所限制的外科系统,如手术室和机器人平台的可靠知识转移.

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we propose SurgPace, a complexity-aware continuous curriculum distillation framework for building compact surgical MLLMs.
SurgPace trains the student with difficulty-aware sample pacing and progressive multi-level alignment.
At the sample level, SurgPace estimates the complexity of each multimodal instance using predictive confidence and Lorentz geometric consistency from the teacher. The two measures are fused into one complexity score, so that lower-complexity samples receive larger weights in early training, and this bias is gradually reduced as training proceeds.
At the objective level, SurgPace uses hierarchical representation alignment to operationalize structured knowledge transfer. The student is aligned with the teacher at probability, logit, and hidden-representation levels, while the balance between distillation loss and task loss changes over time. Early training focuses more on teacher-guided transfer, while later training gives more weight to ground-truth supervision. This design separates sample-level curriculum from objective-level scheduling and gives the student a stable learning path. Figure 1 provides an overview of SurgPace and its training workflow.
Specifically, the contributions of this work are summarized as follows: 1. We formulate SurgPace around two coordinated axes: sample-level pacing controls the emphasis on training examples, and objective-level scheduling controls the balance between teacher and task supervision. 2. We combine teacher predictive confidence and Lorentz trajectory dispersion into a complexity score that guides continuous easy-to-hard weighting within hierarchical feature-, logit-, and probability-level alignment. 3. We validate the SurgPace framework on the Surg-396K benchmark, which is built from four public surgical datasets and covers five dialogue paradigms. Extensive experiments and ablations demonstrate strong performance compared to state-of-the-art methods.
blocks.zh:
为了应付这些挑战,我们提议使用SurgPace,这是建立紧凑外科MLLMs的复杂而有意识的连续课程提炼框架。
SurgPace对学生进行有困难意识的样本间隔和渐进多层次对接的训练.
在样本层面,SurgPace利用教师的预测置信度和洛伦茨几何一致性来估计每个多模式实例的复杂性. 这两种措施被融合成一个复杂性分数,这样低复杂性样本在早期训练中获得更大的分量,这种偏差随着训练的进行而逐渐减少.
在目标层面,SurgPace采用分级代表制,以实施结构化的知识转让。 学生与老师在概率,对数,和隐藏代表水平上一致,而蒸馏损失和任务损失之间的平衡随时间而变化. 早期培训更注重教师指导的调职,而后期培训则更注重地面实况监督。 这种设计将样本级课程与目标级日程区分开来,让学生有一个稳定的学习路径. 图1概述了SurgPace及其培训工作流程。
具体来说,这项工作的贡献总结如下: 1. 我们围绕两个协调轴线制定SurgPace:样本级间隔控制对培训实例的强调;客观级调度控制教师与任务监督之间的平衡。 2. 我们把教师预测信心和Lorentz轨迹的分散性结合起来,形成一个复杂度分,指导在等级特征、对数和概率水平的一致范围内不断进行容易硬度加权。 3. 我们以Surg-396K基准验证SurgPace框架,该框架由四个公共外科数据集所建立,涵盖五个对话模式。 与最先进的方法相比,广泛的实验和活化表现出了强大的性能.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multimodal Large Language Models in Surgical Scenarios
blocks.zh: 2.1 手术场景中的多式大型语文模型

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are shifting surgical AI from single-task, procedure-specific predictors toward interactive assistants that jointly model visual perception, domain knowledge, and natural-language reasoning [ 35 ] . Early surgical MLLM systems primarily focused on tool-use orchestration: VS-Assistant [ 7 ] translates surgeon intent into structured sequences of algorithmic calls via function-calling tuning, and SurgFC [ 6 ] further unifies intention understanding with downstream vision modules into a single surgical interface. However, such orchestration-centric designs remain constrained by limited visual representation and domain grounding. To address this, GP-VLS [ 38 ] injects surgical textbooks and medical knowledge into a general-purpose surgical vision language model (VLM), enabling broader procedural competence, yet it remains largely image-centric and insufficient for fine-grained temporal reasoning in long operations.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)正在将外科AI从单任务,程序特定预测器转移到互动助理,这些助理共同模拟视觉感知,域知识,以及自然语言推理[35]. 早期外科MLLM系统主要侧重于工具-用管弦:VS-Apple [7]通过函数调用调用将外科意向转化为有条理的算法调用序列,而SurgFC [6]将意向理解与下游视觉模块进一步统一为单一外科接口. 然而,这种以管弦为中心的设计仍然受到视觉表现和领域定位有限的限制。 为了解决这一问题,GP-VLS[38]将外科教科书和医学知识注入了通用外科视觉语言模型(VLM),使程序能力更加广泛,然而它在很大程度上仍然是以图像为中心,不足以在长效操作中进行精细的时间推理.

blocks.en: To overcome these limitations, recent work has pursued richer visual grounding and broader multimodal dialogue capabilities. LLaVA-Surg [ 23 ] introduces large-scale structured surgical video instruction tuning to support multi-turn dialogue across diverse procedures, while EndoChat [ 46 ] advances grounded surgical dialogue through explicit multi-scale visual tokenization for endoscopic scenes. In parallel, SurgVLP [ 55 ] improves surgical language-vision alignment via contrastive pretraining on lecture video-text pairs but still requires task-specific adaptation for interactive intraoperative question-answering (QA). Building on these foundations, SurgVidLM [ 47 ] and SurgLLM [ 8 ] further strengthen surgical multimodal understanding through enhanced visual modeling and context-aware pretraining strategies. Despite these advances, intraoperative deployment remains challenging due to strict latency and hardware constraints, as robust temporal reasoning often relies on large backbones and computationally intensive video encoders [ 30 ] . In this context, knowledge distillation offers a practical way to retain core multimodal capabilities while transferring them into more efficient models for surgical assistance.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,最近的工作力求建立更丰富的视觉基础和更广泛的多式联运对话能力。 LLaVA-Surg [23] 引入了大规模结构化外科手术视频指示调制,以支持跨不同程序的多回合对话,而EndoChat [46] 通过对内窥场景的清晰多尺度可视化标识,推进了基于外科手术的对话. 与此同时,SurgVLP[55]通过讲座视频文本对等的对比性预训,改进了外科语言-视觉的对接,但仍需要针对具体任务进行修改,以进行互动的操作内问答(QA). 在这些基础上,SurgVidLM[47]和SurgLLM[8]进一步加强了外科手术多模式理解,加强了视觉模型和对上下文的认识预培训战略. 尽管取得了这些进展,但业务内部署仍然具有挑战性,因为严格的延迟和硬件限制,因为强有力的时间推理往往依赖于大型骨干和计算密集的视频编码器[30]. 在这方面,知识提炼为保留核心多式联运能力提供了一种实际方法,同时将这些能力转化为更有效的外科援助模式。

blocks.en: 2.2 Distilling Multimodal Large Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 稀释多式大型语文模式

blocks.en: The rapid scaling of MLLMs has made knowledge distillation a primary route toward deployable models without retraining from scratch. Early work on efficient VLMs combines teacher-student distillation with structural sparsification, exemplified by EfficientVLM [ 49 ] , which distills a large VLM during pretraining and applies modal-adaptive pruning to remove redundant components. As MLLMs evolve toward instruction-following and open-ended multimodal dialogue, subsequent studies focus on what to distill and where supervision should be applied. LLAVADI [ 52 ] systematically analyzes MLLM distillation design choices and emphasizes jointly aligning token-level behavior and output distributions, while CoMD [ 24 ] moves beyond one-way imitation by introducing competitive distillation to improve student multimodal competence. To better preserve multimodal reasoning, LLaVA-KD [ 4 ] and MoVE-KD [ 5 ] distill cross-modal relations and complementary visual knowledge, respectively, and LLaVA-MoD [ 41 ] further reduces inference cost through sparse MoE design with progressive and preference-aware distillation. Orthogonally, architectural substitutions paired with distillation, such as MaTVLM [ 26 ] , replace parts of the Transformer with Mamba-style layers to recover performance under lower latency.
blocks.zh: 快速扩展的MLLMs使得知识分馏成为不从零开始再培训而实现可部署模式的主要途径. 关于高效VLM的早期工作结合了师生蒸馏和结构斯帕化,以高效VLM[49]为典型,在预训期间蒸馏出一个大型VLM,并应用了模式-适应活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性 随着 mLLMs向遵循指令和开放式多模式对话的方向发展,随后的研究侧重于如何提炼以及应在哪些地方实施监督。 LLAVADI [52] 系统分析MLLM蒸馏设计选择,并强调联合调整符号级行为和输出分布,而CoMD [24] 通过引入竞争性蒸馏来提高学生多模式能力,超越单向仿真. 为了更好地维护多模式推理,LLaVA-KD[4]和MOVE-KD[5]分别分馏了跨模式关系和互补视觉知识,而LLaVA-MoD[41]则通过零星的MOE设计,以渐进式和偏好式分馏来进一步降低推论成本. 外形上,建筑替代与蒸馏相配,如MATVLM [26],用曼巴式地层来取代变形器的部件来恢复低等空闲下性能.

blocks.en: Beyond objectives and architectures, distillation performance also depends on supervision quality and training dynamics. Self-Improving Teacher improves student transfer by calibrating distillation through challenging samples that refine teacher supervision [ 25 ] . Importantly, recent work increasingly treats distillation as a curriculum rather than a one-shot compression step. Curriculum extraction [ 12 ] and progressive consistency distillation [ 51 ] demonstrate that staged learning trajectories improve distillation stability and efficiency. Explicit curriculum scheduling has also been explored for knowledge distillation in more generic settings, like CKD-MDSR [ 43 ] , but remains comparatively underexplored for MLLMs and efficiency-critical domains such as surgical assistance.
blocks.zh: 除了目标和结构外,蒸馏性能还取决于监督质量和培训动态。 "自修""教师"通过精细化教师监管的有挑战性的样本来校正分馏来改善学生的转移[25]. 重要的是,最近的工作越来越多地把蒸馏作为课程而不是一发一发的压缩步骤。 课程取出[12]和渐进一致性分馏[51]表明分级学习轨迹提高了分馏稳定性和效率. 还在CKD-MDSR[43]等较通用的环境下探索了明确的课程时间安排,以进行知识分解,但对于MLLM和手术援助等效率关键领域,仍然相对未得到充分探索。

blocks.en: 2.3 Advances in Curriculum learning
blocks.zh: 2.3 课程学习的进展

blocks.en: Curriculum learning (CL) is a machine learning strategy that arranges training data, tasks, or objectives from simpler to more complex instances to improve convergence and generalization, inspired by human pedagogical principles [ 42 ] . Early work formalized CL as a training paradigm where model performance benefits from gradually increasing complexity of examples, and established general frameworks involving difficulty measurers and training schedulers [ 50 ] . Beyond traditional data-level curricula, recent work has extended CL principles to efficient training of large neural architectures. For large language models (LLMs), curriculum distillation frameworks systematically structure training sequences to first solidify basic competencies before introducing harder reasoning tasks, yielding improved performance over single-stage distillation [ 20 ] . In vision-language settings, curriculum strategies have been shown to benefit multimodal evaluation by pacing training samples according to complexity, especially under limited data regimes [ 37 ] . Moreover, curriculum learning has been applied in large-scale language model pretraining, where ordering examples by difficulty metrics consistently improves convergence and early training efficiency compared to random sampling [ 60 ] . In application-specific domains, specialized curricula designed by domain experts substantially improve clinical disease staging and referral outcomes for medical vision-language models compared to baseline training strategies [ 16 ] . These advances collectively indicate that curriculum learning constitutes a flexible training paradigm that can be adapted for both general efficiency gains and domain-specific performance, motivating its integration with knowledge distillation and adaptive scheduling strategies in surgical MLLMs.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we present SurgPace, a complexity-aware continuous curriculum framework for progressive distillation of surgical vision-language models. The key idea is to estimate the teacher-derived complexity of each training sample, convert this estimate into a continuous easy-to-hard sample pacing mechanism, and couple this sample-level curriculum with hierarchical representation alignment. This formulation explicitly separates two roles that are often entangled in curriculum-based distillation: curriculum determines which samples should receive greater emphasis during training, whereas progressive objective scheduling determines how different supervision signals should be balanced over time. We instantiate SurgPace with EndoChat [ 46 ] as the teacher (13B) and a lightweight multimodal model as the student (3B). The student follows a TinyLLaVA-style architecture built on Phi-2 [ 17 ] , with a SigLIP [ 58 ] vision encoder and a two-layer GELU-based MLP connector, and is initialized from a pretrained Phi-2-SigLIP checkpoint [ 18 ] . Motivation: Teacher-Informed Complexity Estimation. Curriculum learning improves optimization by modulating how training samples are emphasized according to their complexity. In vision-language models, however, complexity is rarely captured by superficial cues such as image appearance or text length alone. Instead, it often arises from semantic ambiguity, cross-modal alignment difficulty, and uncertainty in sequence generation. Existing curriculum strategies therefore commonly rely on heuristic proxies, such as current loss values or metadata-derived priors, which can be noisy, unstable, and highly sensitive to the training dynamics. We adopt a teacher-informed perspective: a sample is considered difficult when a strong teacher model exhibits uncertainty or internal inconsistency while generating the target answer associated with that sample. This view anchors curriculum construction in teacher response behavior for progressive distillation.

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview of SurgPace
blocks.zh: 3.1 SurgPace概览

blocks.en: SurgPace integrates two coordinated training mechanisms into a hierarchical distillation base. The distillation base specifies what knowledge is transferred from the teacher to the student, the curriculum mechanism determines which samples should be emphasized at different stages of training, and the progressive objective schedule governs how distillation and supervised objectives are balanced over time. As illustrated in Figure 2 , each training sample is first assigned a scalar complexity score derived from teacher confidence and Lorentz geometric consistency with respect to the target answer. These precomputed scores are then transformed into progress-dependent sample weights, giving rise to a continuous easy-to-hard pacing strategy whose effect gradually decays as training advances. In parallel, the student is optimized with supervised cross-entropy and hierarchical representation alignment, which jointly enforces distribution alignment, logit matching, representation alignment, and entropy regularization. Their relative contributions are further adjusted through the progressive objective schedule along the training trajectory. In this design, the curriculum acts at the sample level, whereas the objective schedule acts at the loss level. Together, these components make SurgPace a unified and effective framework for stable and efficient progressive distillation of surgical vision-language models.

blocks.en: Our curriculum is built on two tightly coupled components: a teacher-derived complexity estimator and a continuous pacing function that converts this estimator into optimization weights. A key design choice is to explicitly separate offline scoring from online weighting . In the surgical MLLM setting, online complexity estimation is highly unstable because batch sizes are small and the student distribution evolves rapidly during training, whereas teacher-derived offline scores remain globally comparable throughout optimization. We therefore compute a scalar score for each training instance once, store it with the dataset, and reuse this fixed signal during training. Under this design, curriculum is not implemented as a heuristic reshuffling of mini-batches, but as a dataset-level prior that induces smooth and progress-dependent sample emphasis. blocks.en: This hierarchical representation alignment objective defines the objective-side core of SurgPace. We formulate teacher-student transfer as a unified multi-level alignment objective under the curriculum-defined sample pacing and the progressive schedule introduced later in Sec. 3.4 . Concretely, teacher and student are aligned at three complementary levels: output distributions, pre-softmax response patterns, and latent representations, while all terms share the same token mask, per-sample reduction, and sample-aware weighting scheme. This design is important because multimodal compression errors rarely emerge at only one level. A student may appear correct at the surface output level while already drifting in logit geometry or hidden-state organization, and such hidden inconsistencies are particularly harmful for surgical dialogue and grounding tasks that rely on stable cross-modal reasoning.

blocks.en: Overall, the four losses above jointly instantiate hierarchical representation alignment as a unified multi-level distillation objective. They use the same token mask, per-sample reduction, and curriculum weight before entering the progressive objective schedule. By aligning the student with the teacher at the distribution, logit, and latent levels within the same optimization design, this objective provides a stronger and more reliable foundation for compressed surgical vision-language learning.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,上述四个损失共同即时分级代表制调整,作为统一的多层次分馏目标. 在进入进步客观时间表之前,它们使用相同的同义口罩,每个样本减少,以及课程重量. 通过在同一优化设计中使学生与分布、登录和潜在水平的教师保持一致,这一目标为压缩外科视觉语言学习提供了更有力和更可靠的基础。

blocks.en: The final objective unifies the sample-level curriculum above with an objective-level schedule for progressive distillation and supervised learning within a single optimization formulation. These two mechanisms play distinct roles and should be treated separately: curriculum determines which samples should matter more at a given stage, whereas the progressive objective schedule determines which supervision signal should dominate at that stage. This design makes the interaction between sample pacing and supervision scheduling explicit and more systematically controlled in the final training objective.

blocks.en: 4.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en:
All experiments were conducted on the Surg-396K surgical multimodal instruction benchmark [ 46 ] . The benchmark is derived from four public datasets, namely CoPESD [ 48 ] , Cholec80-VQA [ 40 ] , EndoVis17-VQLA, and EndoVis18-VQLA [ 1 ] .
The open-source benchmark provides various tasks in surgical scenes, including spatial grounding, instrument recognition, instrument counting, object position, target tissue, fine-grained motion, and direction, enabling the benchmark to cover both semantic understanding and localized reasoning. We evaluate SurgPace on five dialogue paradigms (single-phrase QA, visual QA, detailed description, region-based QA, and grounding QA, as presented in Table 1 ) to assess whether a compact surgical MLLM can retain broad multimodal capability after distillation.
For all experiments, we use a fixed processed split consisting of 461,297 training instances, 64,878 validation instances, and 64,856 test instances, covering 591,031 instruction-tuning QA pairs in total.
The same split is used for all baselines, ablations, and final comparisons.

所有试验都是在Surg-396K手术多式教学基准上进行的。 该基准取自四个公共数据集,即CoPESD [48],Cholec80-VQA [40],EndoVis17-VQLA,和EndoVis18-VQLA [1].
开源基准在外科手术场景中提供各种任务,包括空间地平面,仪器识别,仪器计数,物体位置,目标组织,细纹运动,以及方向等,使基准既能涵盖语义理解,又能涵盖局部推理. 我们评价SurgPace的五个对话范式(单词QA、视觉QA、详细描述、基于区域的QA和地面QA,如表1所示),以评估精密外科MLLM在蒸馏后能否保留广泛的多模式能力。

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2 执行细节

blocks.en:
All student methods, including SurgPace and the comparison methods, use the same 3B TinyLLaVA-style student architecture built on Phi-2 with a SigLIP vision tower and a two-layer GELU-based multimodal connector. All methods use the same pretrained Phi-2–SigLIP student initialization and the same EndoChat teacher for distillation.
For parameter-efficient tuning, all student methods use LoRA on the language model, keep the vision tower frozen, and fully fine-tune the multimodal connector. The shared LoRA configuration uses rank 64, scaling factor α = 128 \alpha=128 , and bias=None . LoRA targets q_proj , k_proj , v_proj , dense , mlp.fc1 , and mlp.fc2 in the 32 language-model layers, giving 192 target modules. Thus, the parameter-efficient fine-tuning setup is shared; the method-specific differences arise mainly from the distillation objectives and training strategies.
A lightweight learnable projection layer is introduced for teacher-student logit alignment. Input images are processed under a square aspect-ratio policy, visual features are extracted from the penultimate vision layer, and the maximum sequence length is set to 1024 tokens.
All student methods use BF16 with DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 [ 34 ] and the same AdamW optimizer [ 27 ] , learning rate 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , cosine decay, and warm-up ratio 0.03. The main experiments are run for one epoch with a per-device batch size of 1 on two NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs.
The fixed processed split contains 461,297 training instances, 64,878 validation instances, and 64,856 test instances, and is used for all comparison methods, ablations, and final evaluations. Fine-tuning strategies differ by method, but all methods are based on supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Training budgets are not identical. Table 17 reports the per-method GPU-hours; for SurgPace, the reported total includes 52.443 GPU-hours of training and 3.11 GPU-hours of offline difficulty scoring. Across all seven compared methods, the mean total is 71.572 GPU-hours, with a maximum of 165.514 GPU-hours for LLaVA-KD and a minimum of 37.890 GPU-hours for ULD.
For comparison, we evaluate against MiniLLM [ 11 ] , EfficientVLM [ 49 ] , ULD [ 3 ] , LLaVA-KD [ 4 ] , LLaVA-MoD [ 41 ] , and CKD-MDSR [ 43 ] , and report EndoChat [ 46 ] as the teacher reference.
For the common generation protocol, all student methods use the same original questions and the common conversation template used in the TinyLLaVA-based implementation [ 18 ] . The shared settings include automatic insertion of one <image> token, greedy decoding with num_beams=1 and max_new_tokens=256 , skip_special_tokens=True , and identical whitespace and terminal stop-string handling.
At the metric stage, outputs are lowercased, <image> is replaced with a space, and the same token normalization is applied before exact-match and overlap evaluation; ROUGE, BLEU/CIDEr/METEOR, and Grounding use the same respective evaluation procedures for all methods.
The complexity scores are computed once offline using forward passes through the teacher. Scoring all 591,031 instances required 3.11 GPU hours, and the resulting scores are reused throughout training.

blocks.en: The teacher reference has a different task profile. Single Phrase QA rewards the canonical short target form, which the student produces more consistently; semantically related but differently formatted teacher responses are penalized by these exact-answer measures. The teacher’s higher values on several overlap metrics for open answers, regional reasoning, and spatial localization are consistent with its larger capacity. blocks.en:
The advantage of SurgPace further extends to tasks requiring structured reasoning and fine-grained visual grounding. Among student methods, it achieves the best ROUGE-L score on Detailed Description (0.3621), reflecting improved coherence in long-form generation. On Region-Based QA, it ranks first among student methods across all reported metrics, including CIDEr (0.3311) and METEOR (0.6010), indicating strong capability in region-aware language generation and cross-modal alignment. On Grounding QA, the SurgPace student achieves the best results among student methods in AP50 (0.9625) and mIoU (0.8471), suggesting that spatial reasoning ability is effectively preserved after distillation. These observations indicate that SurgPace enables a compact model to generalize well across heterogeneous multimodal tasks, including recognition, generation, regional reasoning, and grounding, while maintaining stable performance across different evaluation settings.
Additionally, Figure 4 provides a compact summary of the results across the five dialogue paradigms. It further shows that SurgPace achieves the strongest overall performance, consistent with the above-mentioned quantitative comparisons.
blocks.zh:
SurgPace的优势进一步扩展到需要结构化推理和精细的视觉地基化的任务. 在学生方法中,它在"详细描述"(0.3621)上实现了最佳的ROUGE-L分数,反映了长形生成中的一致性得到提高. 在区域质量评估方面,它在所有报告的指标中,包括在学生方法中排名第一,包括CIDEr(0.3311)和METEOR(0.6010),这表明在区域认知语言生成和跨模式对接方面能力很强。 在地平分QA上,SurgPace的学生在AP50(0.9625)和mIoU(0.8471)中取得了学生方法中的最佳成绩,表明空间推理能力在蒸馏后得到了有效保存. 这些意见表明,SurgPace使一个紧凑的模式能够很好地概括各种多式联运任务,包括识别、生成、区域推理和地基定位,同时在不同评价环境中保持稳定的绩效。
此外,图4还简要总结了五个对话模式的成果。 进一步显示SurgPace实现最强的整体性能,与上述定量比较一致.

blocks.en: Effects of the Complexity Score Fusion. Table 11 studies the offline fusion rule introduced in Sec. 3.2 and Eq. ( 10 ). Among the single-score variants, s lorentz s_{\mathrm{lorentz}} performs better than s conf s_{\mathrm{conf}} on most metrics, showing that the geometric score provides an effective alternative to confidence-based difficulty estimation. Combining the two signals further improves the overall results. The proposed minimum fusion s min s_{\min} achieves the highest mean across the ten metrics (0.6585), followed by mean fusion (0.6567), Lorentz-only (0.6558), maximum fusion (0.6547), and confidence-only (0.6504).

blocks.en: Effects of the Curriculum Order. Table 12 examines how the ordering of samples affects curriculum training. The proposed easy-to-hard order achieves the best performance on all ten metrics. In contrast, reversing the curriculum to hard-to-easy consistently reduces performance, while mixed ordering also remains below easy-to-hard across all task families. These results show that the benefit is associated with the direction of the curriculum rather than simply exposing the model to samples with different complexity levels.
blocks.zh: 课程法令的效果。 表12审查了样本的订购如何影响课程培训。 拟议的简单而硬的订单在所有10个标准上都取得了最佳的性能. 与此相反,将课程改为难易的做法,始终会降低业绩,而所有任务家庭的混合订单也仍然低于容易完成的水平。 这些结果显示,这种好处与课程的方向有关,而不是简单地将模型暴露于不同复杂程度的样本.

blocks.en: The three strategies differ in how the estimated complexity is used during training. Mixed ordering does not impose a consistent progression over difficulty, whereas hard-to-easy emphasizes more difficult samples first. Easy-to-hard instead prioritizes lower-complexity samples early and gradually increases the contribution of harder samples as training proceeds. Its consistent advantage suggests that establishing the teacher–student transfer on easier samples before increasing sample complexity provides a more suitable optimization trajectory for distillation. We therefore adopt easy-to-hard ordering in the final configuration.
blocks.zh: 三种战略在培训期间如何使用估计的复杂性方面各不相同。 混合订单不会把持续的进展强加于困难,而难易的则首先强调更难的样品。 简单到硬的相反,很早就将低复杂度的样品列为优先事项,随着训练的进行,更难的样品的贡献逐渐增加. 其一贯的优势表明,在提高样本复杂度之前将师生转移放在比较容易的样本上,为蒸馏提供了更合适的优化轨迹。 因此,我们在最后布局中采取易于硬化的命令。

blocks.en: Effects of the Curriculum Pacing Function. In SurgPace, the pacing function is the continuous weighting function defined in Sec. 3.2 . It maps the offline complexity score s i s_{i} to the progress-dependent sample weight w i ′ ​ ( p ) w^{\prime}_{i}(p) through Eqs. (11)-(14). In practice, it controls how training moves from emphasizing easy samples to exposing the model to a more balanced sample set. We compare one non-progressive variant (one-pass) and four progressive schedules (i.e., baby-step, root, geometric, and linear pacing) with the same score signal.
blocks.zh: 课程编程函数的效果。 在SurgPace中,相距函数是Sec中定义的连续加权函数. 3.2 (英语). 它将离线复杂度的分数 s i s i i (i) 映射到依赖进度的样本重量 w (p) w ^{\prime i (p) 通过 Eqs. (11)- (14). 在实践中,它控制着培训如何从强调简单样本到披露模型到更加平衡的样本集. 我们比较一个非渐进变体(一通)和四个渐进表(即婴儿步,根相,几何相和线相),得出相同的分数信号.

blocks.en: The pacing study in Table 13 examines gradual reweighting and disjoint exposure. One-pass partitions the score range into three disjoint bins, activates only the current bin, and does not replay samples from earlier bins. The w/o curriculum setting assigns unit weight to every sample at every step. The one-pass design reduces effective exposure per sample and introduces abrupt changes in training support, yielding a mean of 0.5910 across the ten metrics; w/o curriculum obtains 0.6541.
blocks.zh: 表13中的时间间隔研究审查了逐渐再加权和脱节的接触。 单行道将分数范围分解为三个脱联的分数箱,只激活当前分数箱,不从更早分数箱重放样本. w/o课程设置在每个步骤上给每个样本分配单位权重. 单行道设计减少了每个样本的有效暴露,并突然改变了培训支助,在10个标准中平均为0.5910;w/o课程获得0.6541。

blocks.en: Among the progressive alternatives, linear pacing has the highest mean across the ten metrics (0.6585) and is best on nine of them. Geometric pacing is higher only on Visual QA BLEU-3 (0.3778 versus 0.3764). The schedules differ in how quickly they relax easy-first weighting, and this isolated reversal indicates that n-gram precision is sensitive to that relaxation rate. Root pacing is the next most consistent alternative (0.6529), whereas baby-step pacing is weaker, consistent with its abrupt cumulative support changes. We select linear pacing because its gradual transition gives the strongest aggregate and the best result on the other nine metrics.
blocks.zh: 在渐进式替代品中,线性间距在10个度量衡(0.6585)中的平均值最高,在其中9个度量衡上最好。 几何间距仅在视觉QA BLEU-3上较高(0.3778比0.3764). 时刻表在如何快地放松轻松的第一重力上有所不同,这种孤立的倒置表明正克精度对这个放速率很敏感. 根相距是下一个最一致的可选方案(0.6529),而婴儿步相距较弱,符合其突然的累积支持变化. 我们选择线性速度,因为它的逐步过渡给其他9个指标带来最强的总和最佳结果。

blocks.en: Effects of Complexity Scoring and Online Pacing. Table 14 isolates the sample-level additions while retaining the progressive objective schedule in every row. The objective schedule only control assigns unit weight to every sample. Adding the informative complexity score as a static weight raises the mean across the ten metrics from 0.6541 to 0.6554, and further introducing linear progress-dependent pacing raises it to 0.6585. The full setting is best on eight of ten metrics. Objective schedule only obtains 0.3783 on Visual QA BLEU-3, and static scoring obtains 0.6051 on Region-Based QA METEOR. The first local gain occurs without changing the sample distribution, while the second occurs when the difficulty bias is retained throughout training. Annealing the score-dependent weights restores balanced exposure late in training and gives the strongest aggregate, with a trade-off on these two individual overlap metrics.
blocks.zh: 复杂度分红和在线平分的影响。 表14隔离了样本级的添加,同时保留了每行的渐进目标时间表. 目标时间表只指定每个样本的单位重量。 将信息性复杂性分数作为静态加权值,将10个度数的平均值从0.6541提高到了0.6554,并进一步引入线性进展依赖速度,将其提高到了0.6585。 10个标准中的8个最合适 目标时间表在视觉QA BLEU-3上只获得0.3783分,静态分数在区域QA METEOR上获得0.6051分. 第一个本地收益是在不改变样本分布的情况下发生的,而第二个是在整个培训中保留难度偏差。 将分数依赖的权重进行安放,恢复了训练后期的平衡暴露,并给出了最强的总和,同时权衡这两个个体重叠度量.

blocks.en: Effects of the Phase Transition Design. Table 15 shows that the phase transition design also affects performance. In Sec. 3.4 and Eq. ( 23 ), the stage coefficient α ⁡ ( p ) \alpha(p) determines the supervision scales β dist ​ ( p ) \beta_{\mathrm{dist}}(p) and β ce ​ ( p ) \beta_{\mathrm{ce}}(p) in Eq. ( 24 ). Continuous transition changes this balance smoothly, whereas the two discrete variants use hard stage boundaries. The discrete (3,3,4) schedule remains competitive with a mean of 0.6564 across the ten metrics, while discrete (2,6,2) obtains 0.6538.
blocks.zh: 阶段过渡设计的影响. 表15显示,阶段过渡设计也影响到业绩。 在3.4和Eq. (23)中,相位系数α-(p)\alpha(p)决定了监督尺度β dit (p)\β mathrm{dist * (p)和β ce (p)\β mathrm{ce (p) 在Eq. (24)中。 持续的过渡会平稳地改变这种平衡,而两个离散的变体则使用硬相相接边界. 离散(3,3,4)时间表仍然具有竞争力,平均为0.6564,跨越10个度量,而离散(2,6,2)时间表获得0.6538。

blocks.en: The continuous transition achieves the highest mean across the ten metrics (0.6585) and the best value on all ten. This consistent result supports smooth interpolation as the final setting and suggests that avoiding abrupt objective changes benefits the student across recognition, generation, regional reasoning, and grounding.
blocks.zh: 持续过渡在10个衡量标准(0.6585)中实现了最高平均值,在所有10个衡量标准中实现了最佳值。 这一一致的结果支持将平稳地插入作为最后的设定,并表明避免突然的客观变化有利于学生在认知、生成、区域推理和基础方面。

blocks.en: Effects of the Hierarchical Representation Alignment Objective. We further study the contribution of each loss term in the hierarchical representation alignment objective by removing one loss from the full setting at a time. As defined in Sec. 3.3 and Eq. ( 28 ), the final objective combines supervised cross-entropy with distribution alignment ℓ i K ​ L \ell_{i}^{KL} , logit alignment ℓ i L ​ 2 \ell_{i}^{L2} , latent alignment ℓ i f ​ e ​ a ​ t \ell_{i}^{feat} , and entropy regularization ℓ i e ​ n ​ t \ell_{i}^{ent} . We first observe that removing the main supervision terms KL or L2 leads to severe degradation across all task families. We therefore omit these unstable cases from Table 16 and focus on the two informative auxiliary losses.
blocks.zh: 等级代表制统一目标的效果。 我们进一步研究每一损失术语在分级代表制统一目标中的贡献,一次从整个设定中删除一个损失。 如第3.3条和Eq.(28)所定义,最终目标结合了受监督的交叉对接与分布对接l i K L\ ell\ i\ {KL}, 登录对接l i L 2\ ell\ i\ L2}, 潜在对接l i f e a t\ ell\ i\ feat}, 以及 Entropy正规化l i e n t\ ell\ i\ } 我们首先指出,取消主要监督术语KL或L2会导致所有任务家庭严重退化。 因此,我们从表16中省略了这些不稳定的情况,并侧重于两个信息丰富的辅助损失。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 16 , full alignment has the highest mean across the ten metrics (0.6585), compared with 0.6536 without latent alignment and 0.6504 without entropy regularization. It is best on nine of ten metrics. Removing entropy regularization yields 0.3780 on Visual QA BLEU-3, AP50 of 0.9577, and mIoU of 0.8301; the full model obtains 0.3764, 0.9625, and 0.8471, respectively. Removing latent alignment yields 0.9607 AP50 and 0.8361 mIoU. BLEU-3 measures one aspect of local n-gram overlap and is not expected to vary monotonically with output-distribution sharpness. Its 0.0016 increase without entropy regularization is therefore treated as a local metric trade-off, while the reductions on the other nine metrics support retaining the full objective. These results associate latent alignment with grounded multimodal structure and entropy regularization with broad decoding stability.
blocks.zh: 如表16所示,在10个衡量标准(0.6585)中,完全对等的平均值最高,而没有潜在对等的平均值为0.6536;没有对等的平均值为0.6504。 这最好在十分之一的九分上 消除肽正性在可视QA BLEU-3上得到0.3780分,AP50为0.9577分,mIoU为0.8301分;全型分别得到0.3764分,0.9625分和0.8471分. 消除潜在对接可产生0.9607 AP50和0.8361 mIoU。 BLEU-3测量局部正克重叠的一个方面,预计不会与输出分布的锐度相异。 因此,其0.0016的增加而不使 en正规化,被视为一种当地衡量的取舍,而其他9个衡量标准的减少则有助于保留全部目标。 这些结果将潜在的调整与基础的多模式结构联系起来,并结合广义的解码稳定性,使企业正规化。

blocks.en: 4.5 Discussion & Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.5 讨论和限制

blocks.en: The experimental results show that surgical MLLM distillation benefits from coordinated design at both the sample level and the objective level. SurgPace achieves the strongest aggregate profile across the five dialogue paradigms. Its configuration combines complexity estimation from teacher responses, easy-to-hard curriculum order, progressive pacing, continuous phase transition, and hierarchical representation alignment. This coordinated optimization retains broad multimodal ability in heterogeneous surgical tasks by controlling sample exposure and supervision balance throughout training.
blocks.zh: 实验结果显示外科MLLM蒸馏从样品一级和客观一级协调设计中受益. SurgPace在五个对话范式中实现了最强的集合剖面. 它的配置结合了从教师反应,容易硬化的课程顺序,渐进速度,连续相接过渡,以及分级代表制等角度对复杂性的估算. 这种协调优化在整个培训过程中通过控制样本接触和监督平衡,在多种多样的外科任务中保留了广泛的多模式能力。

blocks.en: The study has several limitations. (i) Both s conf s_{\mathrm{conf}} and s lorentz s_{\mathrm{lorentz}} are computed offline from teacher responses, so curriculum quality depends on teacher quality. Table 6 quantifies the effect of temperature recalibration and logit noise; analyses with alternative, weaker, and differently biased teachers remain important future work. (ii) The current curriculum uses fixed offline scores and a predefined pacing rule, and its sample weighting does not adapt to changes in student learning status during training. (iii) The efficiency study in Table 10 uses one NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU and precision-matched FP16 configurations; measurements on representative resource-constrained hardware remain future work. (iv) The clinical audit is a blinded LLM comparison against reference text without access to the original image. Prospective clinical validation requires adjudication by surgical experts using the original images. Future work includes more robust difficulty estimation from teacher responses, curriculum control that adapts to the student, efficiency benchmarking on different hardware, and validation by clinicians.
blocks.zh: 该研究有若干局限性。 (一)Sconf s_{\mathrm{conf}}和slorentz s_{\mathrm{lorentz}}都从教师的响应中计算出,因此课程质量取决于教师的质量. 表6量化了温度再校正和登录噪音的影响;与替代、较弱和有不同偏见的教师进行分析仍然是今后的重要工作。 (二)现行课程采用固定离线分数和预设间隔规则,其抽样加权不适应培训期间学生学习状况的变化. (三)表10中的效率研究采用一款NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU和精密相匹配的FP16配置;对具有代表性的资源受限硬件的测量仍然是未来的工作. (四)临床审计是盲目的LLM与参考文本的比较,不接触原始图像. 未来的临床验证需要外科专家使用原始图像进行判断. 未来工作包括从教师的回答、适应学生的课程控制、不同硬件上的效率基准以及临床医生的验证等角度对难度作出更强有力的估计。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This paper presents SurgPace, a complexity-aware continuous curriculum framework for progressive distillation of surgical multimodal large language models. SurgPace combines offline teacher-derived complexity estimation, continuous easy-to-hard sample pacing, hierarchical representation alignment, and progressive objective scheduling within one training framework. Experiments across five dialogue paradigms show strong aggregate performance, and the ablation studies identify the contributions and differences among the individual components. The semantic and efficiency evaluations further characterize output quality and computational benefits. Overall, the results support stable sample pacing and multi-level teacher–student alignment for effective surgical MLLM compression.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍 SurgPace,是逐步分馏外科多式大型语言模型的复杂而有意识的连续课程框架. SurgPace将离线师生复杂程度估计、连续的简单硬的样本速度、分级代表制以及在一个培训框架内的渐进目标时间安排结合起来。 跨越五个对话范式的实验显示出强大的总性能,而衰减研究确定了各个组成部分的贡献和差异. 语义和效率评价进一步说明产出质量和计算效益的特点。 总体而言,结果支持了稳定的样本间距和多层次的师生对接,以有效进行外科MLLM压缩.

blocks.en: The main manuscript reports two complementary semantic evaluations of Detailed Description outputs. The primary evaluation follows the original EndoChat-compatible prompt and returns one integer score from 0 to 100. The protocol in this supplement is a separate, diagnostic, six-dimension clinical audit. It was introduced to expose clinically meaningful error types that can be obscured by lexical overlap metrics or a single aggregate score. The two scores are therefore not merged and should not be interpreted as interchangeable.

blocks.en: The audit uses the same 300 source indices for each of three representative systems: 1. SurgPace ( surgpace_seed42 ); 2. EfficientVLM ( efficientvlm_seed42 ); 3. EndoChat teacher ( endochat_teacher ). Sampling is stratified by dataset and within-dataset reference-length quartile, with 71 cases in each CoPESD quartile and 4 cases in each Endovis quartile. Thus, the run contains 900 audited pairs and 900 judge requests.
